SET IPCONFIG STATIC 2 10.102.18.206 255.255.254.0 10.102.18.1 10.130.4.11 10.130.4.12
SET NIC AUTO 2
SET OA GATEWAY IPV6 2 ::0

#Uncomment the following line to remove IPv6 Static Route configurations for OA's
#REMOVE OA ROUTE IPV6 2 ALL
SET LLF INTERVAL 60
ENABLE LLF
DISABLE ROUTER ADVERTISEMENTS
DISABLE SLAAC
DISABLE DHCPV6
DISABLE IPV6
DISABLE IPV6DYNDNS ACTIVE
DISABLE IPV6DYNDNS STANDBY
ENABLE ENCLOSURE_IP_MODE

# ADD LANGUAGE information

# ADD LANGUAGE [URL]

#Set SSL Ciphers and Protocols

ENABLE SSL CIPHER "EDH-RSA-DES-CBC3-SHA:AES128-SHA:AES256-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA:AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384:AES128-SHA256:AES256-SHA256"

DISABLE SSL CIPHER "DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384"

ENABLE SSL PROTOCOL "TLSv1,TLSv1.1,TLSv1.2"

DISABLE SSL PROTOCOL "(None)"

#Set SSH Ciphers

ENABLE SSH CIPHER "aes128-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes256-ctr,aes128-cbc,3des-cbc,aes192-cbc,aes256-cbc,rijndael-cbc@lysator.liu.se"

DISABLE SSH CIPHER "(None)"

#Set SSH KEX

ENABLE SSH KEX "ecdh-sha2-nistp256,ecdh-sha2-nistp384,ecdh-sha2-nistp521,diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha256,diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1,diffie-hellman-group14-sha1"

DISABLE SSH KEX "(None)"
